title: Pushforwards and higher direct images of adequate modules are adequate
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism f : T -> S and an adequate O_T-module F on (Sch/T)_tau, the lemma asserts that f_* F and all higher direct images R^i f_* F are adequate O_S-modules (statement lines 2107-2113). The proof first rewrites the higher direct images as the cohomology of F over U x_S T, via the morphism-of-sites lemma, the definition of cohomology over an object, the cohomology-of-open lemma and the identification lemma, reducing the claim by sheafification to one statement: for a ring A and a quasi-compact quasi-separated T over A, the functor B -> H^q(T_B, F_B) is adequate. It then proves that statement by cutting T into pieces -- Case I affine, Case II separated by induction on the number of affines, and the general case (proof lines 2116-2218). The level is H3: a displayed reduction plus a genuine induction, with each equality in the introductory computation attributed to a named result.
